results.title: Business Consultant Insurance Professional & General Liability | Hiscox
results.snippet: Hiscox describes professional liability insurance for business consultants as protection against claims of negligence and judgment errors arising from professional services.

results.title: Professional Liability Insurance for Consultants | The Hartford
results.snippet: The Hartford explains that consultant professional liability insurance can help cover legal fees and defense costs and can also help pay covered settlements and judgments.

results.title: Independent Consultant/Non-Specialist Professional Services Providers | Cornell
results.snippet: Cornell's risk guidance says professional liability coverage for consultants can address claims involving negligence, personal injury such as libel and slander, work completed in the past, and employees or independent contractors.

results.title: Professional Liability Insurance FAQs | The Hartford
results.snippet: The Hartford explains that professional liability insurance can help protect a business when a client claims that a mistake in professional services caused a financial loss.

results.title: Professional Liability (Errors & Omissions) Insurance for Consultants | Insureon
results.snippet: Insureon says the cost of professional liability insurance depends on factors including the services offered, revenue, coverage limits, and other business risks.
